title: Passpod Handshake Schema
description: Machine-readable representation of the conceptual Passpod handshake model. The schema represents the canonical flow without embedding implementation transition logic.

handshakeIdentity.description: Stable conceptual identifier that lets participants recognize which messages belong to the same negotiation.

lifecycle.description: Conceptual lifecycle state of the handshake.

terminalClosure.description: Closure concept for terminal handshake outcome. Closure is terminal, but this schema does not implement transition logic.

messages.description: Ordered append-only message history. Ordering is represented by array order; append-only behavior is a semantic requirement outside this schema.

parentRelationships.description: Conceptual parent relationships among messages in the handshake.

profileAssociation.description: Optional profile context associated with the handshake.

versionAssociation.description: Optional version context. The frozen specification does not prescribe version syntax.

extensions.description: Compatible extension points. Extensions must not redefine core semantics.

conceptualIdentifier.description: Identifier concept. The frozen specification does not prescribe identifier syntax.

conceptualReference.description: Reference concept. The frozen specification does not prescribe representation details.

conceptualValue.description: Conceptual value with intentionally unspecified representation.

handshakeLifecycle.description: Conceptual lifecycle state from the State Model.

isClosed.description: Whether the handshake has reached closure.

outcome.description: Conceptual terminal outcome named in the State Model. Profiles may define more specific terminal meanings.

closeMessageReference.description: Reference to the CLOSE message or closure context.

messageReference.description: Reference to the message that has a parent.

relationshipMeaning.description: Optional conceptual meaning of the relationship. The frozen specification does not prescribe controlled values.

extensionValue.description: Extension value. Extensions must not redefine core semantics.
